g.title: j1793197571
g.text: Great... Sooooo... what's new with you?

g.title: j1544501313
g.text: How about that local sport's team, yeah?

g.title: j2050072102
g.text: br00dsw0rd: Mate, we just spoke an hour ago, about-

g.title: j641838563
g.text: br00dsw0rd: It becomes a little less interesting when it's the same every-

g.title: j2804510882
g.text: br00dsw0rd: What's going on? You're acting strange.

g.title: j4093042245
g.text: Amir's bored again. Look at your username.

g.title: j398213659
g.text: br00dsw0rd: I don't believe you, I-

g.title: j2692886837
g.text: Eh, he's just teasing. You know he adores you. lol

g.title: j3429068063
g.text: br00dsw0rd: ... Fine. Fine. Maybe I brood a little.

g.title: j3002547489
g.text: br00dsw0rd: Just... get him to change it back, will you? Before anybody else notices.

g.title: j529974092
g.text: br00dsw0rd: That boy is the definition of idle hands... we need to get him more hobbies...
